title: Vice City Platinum Playbook
list: the official 55 trophies, 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, 28 hidden

platinumMeta.cheatsNote: Cheats disable trophies and saving. No mission replay, no New Game Plus. 15 manual save slots — save at the start and end of each chapter.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own — it is always the last to unlock. No multiplayer or DLC is needed, so the whole list can be done solo in a single playthrough. Budget roughly 200 hours at a relaxed pace, and use the Roadmap tab to plan the three stages.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1; it unlocks automatically as the story starts. Just follow the mission prompts — nothing here can be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 in full; the trophy lands when the first Chapter 2 mission, What's in the Bag?, begins. Keep playing the story and it arrives on its own.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2; it pops as the first Chapter 3 mission, Welcome to Vice City, starts. Story progress only — no side work is needed.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3; it unlocks after the first two Chapter 4 missions, Ocean Beach and Another Life. Pure story progress.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 by completing its final mission, Starting From Zero. The trophy follows automatically.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission at the end of the story (Chapter 5 in some listings). Free roam continues afterwards, so all mop-up work can wait until after the credits.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run. An automatic story trophy — just play the mission through.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist. An automatic story trophy — just play the mission through.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play. An automatic story trophy — just play the mission through.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 mission Headliners. An automatic story trophy — just play the mission through.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown. An automatic story trophy — just play the mission through.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory. An automatic story trophy — just play the mission through.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% Completion — the checklist opens after the story under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion. Progress made during the story already counts, and the bar is lenient at roughly 60% true completion. This is widely rated the hardest trophy, so treat it as the long endgame grind.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts out of 397 in the world: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-bridge passes, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Mixing categories helps, and under-bridge passes are the quickest to rack up. Track the count under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts; 100% completion needs 300.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a car or drone race win, and a stunt. Most of these pop naturally while chasing other trophies, so do not force it early.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 shooting range challenges across 12 range locations, including Rodgers Ranch in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Balsero. Each challenge has three difficulty tiers and some are locked at first, so revisit ranges as the story opens them up.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations (42 races in total). Some races charge an entry fee. Track them under Touch Pad, then Activities, then Drones, then Top Fun Drones.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races from the 40 unique race locations — repeat wins on the same race do not count. Most locations let you hire a car, and the car's rating matters, so pick a strong hire for each new track.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui (Meet Cal), Cal texts you about a fishing challenge marked with a purple map icon. Take a boat and a fishing rod and catch a Parrotfish over 2 kg to beat him.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game all the way through — Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind or Bang For Your Buck. The first three play on the home TV and the fourth on arcade machines; finish every level once, side challenges not needed.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Work through Andy's strand as Lucia in Chapter 3 — it starts with a call from Andy in Belville. Five quests lead to the finale: Climbing the Cellerichain 1 to 3, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. The strand stays available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Follow Kenton's strand, auto-marked in Chapter 1 with a green KR icon at Key Lento. It is treasure diving across 7 shipwrecks with a metal detector; it goes quiet for a stretch of Chapter 1, then returns in Chapters 2 and 3. Track it under Progress, then Characters, then Kenton Rees.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, Billy's strand auto-marks at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Five quests — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and the finale Hometown Heroes — lead to the last mission, and it stays open after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands. The ones confirmed to count are Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete; Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count toward the eight. All of them stay available after the story, so track them with the in-game trophy tracker.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Unlock Randy's strand in Chapter 3 with the Clonin' Keys Makin' GS mission and the Key Cloner, then look for the green RK icon in west Vice City. Randy's Wish List asks for 16 sports cars; delivering them in good condition pays more. Available after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: As Jason, after the Chapter 3 mission Here Kitty Kitty, take on Tyrone's strand: destroy the Synthetic Labs in Take Out Kitty Litter, then run the Spin On This quest to shut the labs down. It stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations — the ONLY trophy that can be missed. In Chapter 1, meditate on Jason's house balcony after Down to Earth, when Lucia invites you from the morning kitchen scene; accept the invite or that spot is gone for good. The final meditation needs both characters, so it only opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. Note: 100% completion needs only 15 of the 18.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: As Jason, after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, Bret texts you and the strand opens in Lummox County with the first quest Veteran Hunted. Hunt the unique animal with the Killtelligence SM-69 hunting rifle. All 15 Target Decks are needed for 100% completion.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets out of 18 in the game (100% needs 15 sets). Cards can be sold at pawn shops without losing progress. Track sets under Progress, then Collections, then Collectible Cards.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK phone app — hold Up plus R1 to scan — at 100 locations: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher Tags. Any 100 count and more than 100 exist, so scan as you travel. Track under Progress, then Collections, then WAiNK Locations.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges (100% needs 70). Pick the easiest ones and skip the hardest; track progress under Progress, then Challenges.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you. Earliest chance is after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break — call your partner with hold Right plus Triangle, build 4 stars, then escape the red heat zone entirely, not just the search area. The train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is the easiest escape; it also pops automatically during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your wanted level, any time after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. The three jewelry stores in north Vice City work well once Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs open in Chapter 3. The pop is delayed about 30 seconds after the third shop — if nothing appears, hit a fourth shop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles out of 557 at launch by scanning them with the WAiNK app — driving them is not needed. 100% completion needs 200 of the 277 base models scanned. Track under Progress, then Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during a single use of Combat Focus (L3 plus R3 while aiming a firearm). It does not work on soldiers, police or civilians, so use it on gang enemies; the Duke 556 assault rifle is a good pick. Buff focus with food, drinks, a shower or Adrenaline, and raise focus levels 1 to 4 through shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal the large passenger plane docked at departure terminal E3/E4 at VCIA. Climb to the cockpit upstairs, reverse onto the airstrip and take off, then fly about 1 km from the airport — the trophy pops with a delay.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank at Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of Mariana County; tanks sit south of the air base. Climb in and open fire on the enemies that respond.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected, after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs unlocks the Snap Gun silent lockpick. Enter through the back door — the safe code is on a note in the backroom. Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City is a good spot.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Vaults unlock through the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, where you tail a security van; Yasmani also tips you $10,000 after two Payday Loan robberies. Expect a 4-star wanted level on each vault job, with up to $205,000 per bank; 100% completion needs all 8 bank jobs.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. It pops automatically in the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, since the vault counts. Earlier, a sticky bomb on a truck's back door near a bank works — then escape the red heat radius or duck into a Pay 'n' Spray.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida and unfog the whole map — 52 areas. A plane is the fastest way to sweep the map; fly low over each region until its fog lifts.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs (39 operations exist in total; 100% needs all 39). They show as yellow map icons; track them under Progress, then Gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — the method is not yet known as of November 2026: the description points to enjoying a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, but no reliable steps have been published. Do not chase this one until a trusted guide confirms how it triggers; check back after the community pins it down.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — the method is not yet known as of November 2026: the description points to smashing out of a vehicle showroom in classic style, but no reliable steps have been published. Wait for a confirmed method rather than guessing at showrooms.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Work the Kolt and Associates bowling alley — Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, a gang operation. Grab the three key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun at the north-east table, and the safe in the north-east hallway (sticky bombs open it). The trophy pops after you escape the police, not on the third pickup, and the icon respawns if you need another try — nothing here is missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with BOTH Jason and Lucia at the same time, after character switching opens up following the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. Buy a gym membership and work out together — your partner trains automatically while you do.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Build up 500 criminal-profile actions; the counter sits in the trophy list. Profiles run Professional, Hardened, Violent, Psycho and Irredeemable — and Irredeemable is permanent, making cops more aggressive, so avoid pushing that far. If you fall short near the end, running over civilians or cops is the fastest way to top the counter up.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — the method is not yet known as of November 2026; it is believed to involve the Payday Loans store in the prologue, and the description hints at succeeding on a second try. Treat that as a rumour, not a method, until a trusted guide confirms it.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — the method is not yet known as of November 2026; it is believed to tie into a UFO questline, and the description suggests witnessing something strange. Treat that as a rumour until a confirmed method is published.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — the method is not yet known as of November 2026; it is believed to involve kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle, matching the melee drive-by description. Treat that as a rumour until a confirmed method is published.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts — the total is cumulative, not in one go. It unlocks in Chapter 3 with Credit Check and the Dye Pack Jammer; rob banks and Payday Loans, then deliver the bills to a fence (Yasmani pays the most). Bank vaults hold up to $205,000 each, so a few vault jobs cover most of the total.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — cumulative, any shop type. The fastest sinks are guns, car mods and tattoos; the map holds 24 Ammu-Nations, 14 mod shops, 67 clothing stores and 11 tattoo studios.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties for $160,000 total through the Vice City Real Estate phone app, available after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. The four extra story garages do not count toward the eight.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app opens after the Chapter 2 Moses mission (Take A Vehicle to Moses); register at Moses in Port Gellhorn via Respray plus Register, and later Pay 'n' Spray locations work too from Chapter 3. Use cheap cars and bikes to keep costs low, and keep garage spots free for them.

roadmap.title: Stage 1 — Story, 60 to 80 hours
roadmap.text: Play the story and take the optional missions as they appear. Scan vehicles and study animals with binoculars as you travel, and do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation the moment Lucia invites you — it is the one missable spot in the game. Save by hand at the start and end of every chapter; there is no mission replay.

roadmap.title: Stage 2 — 100% Completion, about 100 hours
roadmap.text: After the story, open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion and work the checklist: 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts, 15 of 18 meditations, 15 of 18 card sets, 200 of 277 base vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 100 WAiNK locations, 33 underwater discoveries, 100 Cocaine Flamingos, all robberies, 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 Payday Loan jobs and 8 bank vaults.

roadmap.title: Stage 3 — Cleanup, about 10 hours
roadmap.text: Finish the stranger strands, the five unconfirmed trophies once their methods are pinned down, and whatever miscellaneous trophies are left. The platinum pops the moment the last one lands.
